title: Provider audit: kcapi providers streaming compliance
description:
Audit src/providers/kcapi/kcapi_skcipher.c, kcapi_hash.c, kcapi_aead.c.

The kcapi providers use the kernel crypto API (crypto_skcipher_encrypt, crypto_ahash_update, etc.). Determine whether the current update()/finalize() implementations:
1. Process complete blocks immediately in update() (streaming), or
2. Accumulate all input in update() and process in finalize() (batch)

For skcipher (CBC, CTR, XTS): update() should scatter-gather encrypt complete blocks immediately.
For hash/HMAC/CMAC: update() should call crypto_ahash_update() immediately.
For AEAD (GCM): same GCM streaming constraint as wolfssl — no unauthenticated plaintext on decrypt.

Fix any batch accumulation found. Document findings.
close_reason: kcapi_skcipher converted from batch to streaming: tail[16] replaces inbuf, update() processes complete blocks immediately; kcapi_hash already streaming; kcapi_aead batch retained (AEAD decrypt requires tag verify before plaintext release)
